info.title: Lipi AI
info.description: The integration surface. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer lipi_sk_…`; a key resolves to exactly one workspace and every response is scoped to it. Lists page with an opaque cursor, timestamps are ISO-8601 strings named `…Iso`, and every error at every status is `{ error, details? }`.

apiKey.description: A key minted at `POST /v1/api-keys`. `read` scope covers GET and HEAD; `write` covers everything else and implies read.
